title: The Railway Memorial
author: Barış Kısır
premise: Rugby, 1861. The railway has come to the village of Broadmere, and with it a death: the navvies\' tunnel has collapsed, and the company is burying the dead with a lie — "accident" — to save the line\'s schedule. Widow Martha Hale, who lost her husband to the rails, refuses the lie and begins a memorial for the men the railway will not name.
